name: b5984-lane
prompt: Vertical 9:16 photoreal cinematic, early morning in a small 7th-century Arabian oasis village like early Madinah. A narrow sandy footpath winds between two low single-storey houses with walls of sun-dried mud brick and flat roofs of date-palm trunks and palm leaves plastered with mud, roof edges low enough to touch. The path is worn smooth by footsteps and leads from one doorway to the other; each doorway is covered by a plain dark woven camel-hair curtain. Date palms behind, bright clear blue sky, warm golden low sun, long soft shadows. No people, no animals, no text, no modern objects, no glass windows.
